statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_uptime_targets (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
 label VARCHAR(120),
 is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
 created_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT uq_web_uptime_targets_client_url UNIQUE (client_id, url)
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_uptime_state (
 target_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES web_uptime_targets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
 status_since TIMESTAMPTZ,
 consecutive_failures SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 consecutive_successes SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 failing_since TIMESTAMPTZ,
 blocked_since TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 last_outcome VARCHAR(16),
 last_status_code INTEGER,
 last_error VARCHAR(32),
 last_response_ms INTEGER,
 next_check_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_uptime_state_status CHECK (status IN ('unknown','up','suspect','down','blocked'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_uptime_state_next_check ON web_uptime_state (next_check_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_outages (
 id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 target_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES web_uptime_targets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
 confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
 ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 cause VARCHAR(32),
 status_code INTEGER,
 slack_down_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
 slack_down_sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 slack_recovery_status VARCHAR(16),
 slack_recovery_sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 slack_attempts SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_outages_kind CHECK (kind IN ('down','blocked')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_outages_slack_down CHECK (slack_down_status IN ('pending','sent','failed','skipped')),
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_outages_slack_recovery CHECK (slack_recovery_status IS NULL OR slack_recovery_status IN ('pending','sent','failed','skipped'))
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_web_outages_open ON web_outages (target_id) WHERE ended_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_outages_target_started ON web_outages (target_id, started_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_uptime_probes (
 id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
 target_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES web_uptime_targets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 checked_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
 outcome VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 status_code INTEGER,
 error VARCHAR(32),
 response_ms INTEGER,
 CONSTRAINT ck_web_uptime_probes_outcome CHECK (outcome IN ('up','down','blocked'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_uptime_probes_target_checked ON web_uptime_probes (target_id, checked_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_web_uptime_probes_checked ON web_uptime_probes (checked_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_web_settings (
 client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES clients(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 slack_webhook_url TEXT,
 slack_channel_hint VARCHAR(100),
 slack_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
 slack_revoked_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
 downtime_to_slack BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
 user_agent VARCHAR(300),
 updated_by INTEGER REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
 updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 CONSTRAINT ck_client_web_settings_webhook_encrypted CHECK (slack_webhook_url IS NULL OR slack_webhook_url LIKE 'v1:%')
)
